integrity: Proof is complete finite exhaustion of 4094 words with two independently computed exact readouts. Same-model review only; independent mathematical auditing has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite binary result through length 11 only; ideal length-resolved moment readout; no theorem for longer strings, noisy observations, or larger alphabets. The 2010 conference is dated June 13–18; June 18 is a conservative latest public-day marker rather than a verified exact individual-paper release date. Unindexed earlier two-moment classifications remain possible.
title: The first loss of binary substring-composition information under two-moment compression
